notes: First airborne attempt in this funnel. The preceding run is a fixed-camera bench. Flight motion and PX4 state are recorded independently in flight/track.json. See flight/result.json for bearing and motion measurements.
confounds: Renderer, camera rate, viewpoint and vehicle dynamics changed together between the two runs. The observed error is from the left optical camera. The controller only used the central view of a level, bright-backed opening. Traversal and hardware flight were outside the approved plan.
